title: Sound & Mechanical Waves
intro: Vibrations through strings, air and wood: bottle xylophones, one-string guitars, debe telephones and the physics of Kenyan music.

lessons.title: What Is Sound? Feel the Vibration
lessons.focus: Touch a drummed ngoma skin, a humming throat, a struck ruler on a desk; sound = vibration traveling.
lessons.advanced: Explain why the ruler's pitch rises as you shorten the overhang: link length to vibration rate.

lessons.title: Sound Needs a Medium
lessons.focus: Sound through a desk, through string, not through vacuum; bell-in-a-bottle pump demo attempt; Moon is silent.
lessons.advanced: Argue from particle collisions why sound dies as air is removed; what remains in a perfect vacuum?

lessons.title: Waves Carry Energy, Not Stuff
lessons.focus: Ripples in a basin move a leaf in place; rope transverse vs spring longitudinal waves; wave anatomy drawn.
lessons.advanced: Label crest, trough, wavelength, amplitude on your rope sketch; distinguish wave speed from particle motion.

lessons.title: Wavelength, Frequency, Amplitude and v = fλ
lessons.focus: Count rope waves per second, measure wavelength with chalk; v = fλ for rope and sound.
lessons.advanced: Sound: f=170 Hz, λ=2 m — compute wave speed; predict λ for a drum's 85 Hz.

lessons.title: Measuring the Speed of Sound with an Echo
lessons.focus: Clap toward a far wall; time the echo over known distance; average ten claps; compare with ~340 m/s.
lessons.advanced: Wall 85 m away, echo in 0.5 s: compute speed and the reaction-time error; improve the method.

lessons.title: Build: The Bottle Xylophone I
lessons.focus: Water level sets pitch; six bottles tuned by ear to a scale; striking vs blowing gives different families.
lessons.advanced: Explain why more water raises the struck pitch but lowers the blown pitch (solid vs air column vibrating).

lessons.title: Build: The Bottle Xylophone II — Tune and Play
lessons.focus: Tune against a reference (phone app or teacher ear); play a known tune; record the water levels.
lessons.advanced: If level-to-pitch were linear in air column, would equal water steps make equal note steps? Investigate.

lessons.title: Build: The One-String Guitar I
lessons.focus: Wire/fishing line on a board with bottle bridge; tension by hanging stone; pluck and measure pitch vs length.
lessons.advanced: Predict the half-length pitch using f∝1/L; verify against a tuner app.

lessons.title: Build: The One-String Guitar II — Ratios and Songs
lessons.focus: Find octave (1/2), fifth (2/3), fourth (3/4) positions; mark frets; play with the bottle xylophone ensemble.
lessons.advanced: Derive fret positions from f∝1/L for a pentatonic scale; mark them with measured distances.

lessons.title: Drums: The Physics of the Ngoma
lessons.focus: Tight skin = high pitch; size matters; warming a drum by the fire tightens skin; membrane modes teaser.
lessons.advanced: Explain with tension and wave speed why tightening raises pitch; estimate direction of change with numbers.

lessons.title: Singing Tubes and Bottles: Air Columns Resonate
lessons.focus: Blow across bottles; straw oboe with cut reed; resonance when tube length fits the wave.
lessons.advanced: For a tube closed at one end, λ≈4L: predict the note of a 25 cm tube and test it.

lessons.title: Build: Pan Pipes from Straws
lessons.focus: Cut straws to calculated lengths, plug one end, bind the raft; play a scale; compare with predictions.
lessons.advanced: Compute lengths for an 8-note scale from f∝1/L with your lowest note at 20 cm; list all eight.

lessons.title: Build: The Debe Telephone
lessons.focus: Two tins joined by taut string; sound rides the string; test taut vs slack, long vs short, string vs wire.
lessons.advanced: Explain energy transmission along the string; why does a loose string kill the call?

lessons.title: Loudness: Amplitude and the Decibel Idea
lessons.focus: Big vibration = loud; logarithmic teaser (10× energy = +10 dB); posho mill and ear safety; quiet and loud spots mapped.
lessons.advanced: Posho mill 100 dB vs conversation 60 dB: how many times more sound energy? Show the log reasoning.

lessons.title: Echoes and Sonar: Sound as a Ruler
lessons.focus: Echo ranging revisited; bats and fishermen's fish-finders; compute distances from echo times.
lessons.advanced: Echo returns in 0.30 s: distance? Then: design an echo depth-sounder for a dugout canoe.

lessons.title: Soaking Up Sound: Thatch, Soft Things and Quiet Rooms
lessons.focus: Clap in a bare hall vs grass-thatched space; soft surfaces absorb, hard reflect; classroom acoustics fixes.
lessons.advanced: Propose three low-cost acoustic fixes for a noisy classroom and the physics behind each.

lessons.title: Noise Pollution in Our Town
lessons.focus: Map loud/quiet zones around school and market; health effects; propose a community noise plan.
lessons.advanced: Estimate distance doubling drop (≈ −6 dB in open air): how far must a 100 dB speaker be to reach 70 dB?

lessons.title: The Physics of Kenyan Instruments
lessons.focus: Survey: ngoma, kayamba shaker, orutu, litungu, flutes; classify by vibrating part (string/membrane/air); invite a local player.
lessons.advanced: Write the physics profile of one instrument: vibrator, resonator, pitch control, amplification.

lessons.title: Project: The Class Orchestra
lessons.focus: Assemble bottle xylophones, one-strings, pan pipes, drums; compose and perform a piece; program notes include the physics.
lessons.advanced: Write program notes explaining the pitch physics of your instrument section.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Sound Fair
lessons.focus: Instrument petting zoo, echo game, telephone race; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Quiz-writer task: one question linking f=1/L to a real instrument, with mark scheme.
